description: How much sooner a fixed-rate mortgage (or other fixed-rate loan paid monthly) ends with an extra amount every month, a one-off payment, or both, from today's balance, the way SmartFin's mortgage payoff calculator does. Give the time left (years_left) or the monthly payment from the statement (monthly_payment), not both. Returns the months on each schedule, how many sooner, the interest on the rest of the loan with and without the extra, the difference, the extra paid, the last payment, the smallest whole extra a month that ends the loan 5 years sooner (1 year sooner when 2 to 10 years are left), and what the loan without extra would still owe when the loan with extra is paid off. Use when someone asks how much sooner or with how much less interest extra payments or a lump sum pay off a mortgage, or how much extra a month ends it some years early. Do not use for the payment on a new loan (use smartfin_calculate_loan_payment), refinancing, adjustable-rate or interest-only loans, or whether to pay off early or invest: it does not compare the two. Principal and interest only; taxes, insurance, escrow and prepayment penalties are not included. Each extra payment is applied to principal on its payment date. Amounts can be in any one currency; none is converted.

annual_rate_pct.description: Yearly interest rate, % a year, fixed for the rest of the loan. 0 to 25

currency.description: Currency for the amounts in the summary and the link. Default USD; amounts are never converted

current_balance.description: What is still owed today, from the statement. 1 to 100000000

extra_monthly.description: Extra paid with every monthly payment from the next one, in the same currency. Default 0. 0 to 1000000

lump_sum.description: A one-off extra payment, in the same currency. Default 0. 0 to 100000000

lump_sum_month.description: Which payment the one-off amount is paid with: 1 = the next payment. Default 1. 1 to 480

monthly_payment.description: The monthly payment from the statement, principal and interest only (no escrow). Give this or years_left. 0 to 100000000

years_left.description: Time left on the loan in years (to the nearest month: 2.5 is 2 years 6 months). Give this or monthly_payment. 1 month to 40
